COMBINED_SLOT_D_OPTION_9_&_SLOT_E.note: Combined layers apply only when slot D is the RTD card ('9' at position 10) - the layer names encode both slots (6.xx__9- <slotE>__). The old source read only slot E, so any 751 with a populated slot E got an RTD layer regardless of slot D (2026-08-30 audit, under-conditioned-group). Keys are the real MOT characters: slot D digit 9 + slot E positions 12-13, with 'X' where the catalog fragment uses the '-' filler (same shape as 751A's i7008 group; slot E '70' confirmed by configurator decode of 751501A1A9X70850230). Optional: for non-RTD units the composite matches nothing and SLOT_D draws the panel.

SLOT_D.note: Slot D code '9' ((10) RTD Inputs; configurator-decoded on 751501A1A9X70850230, 2026-08-30) has no standalone layer: the RTD rear panel is drawn by the COMBINED_SLOT_D_OPTION_9_&_SLOT_E layers (6.xx__9- <slotE>__), so '9-' maps to an empty list here rather than warning as unresolved.

part_number.note: MOT = SEL Model Option Table. Position numbers are 1-based digit indices into the PARTNO string and match the layer 'source.position' values. Fully decoded from the official SEL Ordering Information; positions 8-15 are 2-digit composite fields (see 'components').
references: SEL-751 master configuration drawings i7182.C / i7213.C (drawing layers)

Voltage option with arc-flash detector inputs

options.3: Arc Sense (requires 4 ACI/3 AVI card in Slot Z)
options.6: Advanced Directional (200 mA neutral CT; ungrounded/low-Z/high-Z/Petersen coil)
options.8: Reclosing, Advanced Directional, and Arc Sense

positions.label: User Interface (language) | Extended I/O (Slots 1, 2, 3, 4)
positions.note: Combines front-panel overlay language (English/Spanish) with the extended-I/O card set. UBI = Universal Binary Inputs (24-250 Vdc/Vac); EM DO = Electromechanical Digital Outputs.

positions.label: Slot C card | DI voltage
positions.note: First digit = card type, second digit = Digital input voltage. Only one 3 DI/4 DO/1 AO card and one 4 AI/4 AO card allowed per chassis.

options.D: 4 DI / 3 DO Electromechanical (2 Form C, 1 Form B)

positions.label: Slot D card | DI voltage
positions.note: First digit = card type, second digit = Digital input voltage. 10 RTD card (9) is Slot D only.

options.D: 4 DI / 3 DO Electromechanical (2 Form C, 1 Form B)

positions.label: Slot E card | DI voltage
positions.note: First digit = card type, second digit = Digital input voltage / AFDI variant. Voltage/arc-flash (7) and LEA voltage (L) cards live here; MOT digits 12,13.

options.7: Voltage/Arc-Flash or Voltage/7-DI card (Vsync 300 Vac / Vbat 300 Vdc)
options.D: 4 DI / 3 DO Electromechanical (2 Form C, 1 Form B)
options.L: LEA Voltage/Arc-Flash or LEA Voltage/7-DI card (Vsync 8 Vac / Vbat 300 Vdc)

positions.label: Slot Z current & voltage inputs
positions.note: First digit = card type, second digit = Phase / neutral current rating. First digit = measurement family, second digit = phase/neutral current rating; MOT digits 14,15.

options.7: 4 ACI / 3 AVI LEA (Rogowski coil / LPCT, RJ45 inputs)

options.L: Rogowski / LPCT phase, 200 mA neutral, LEA voltage

positions.label: Slot B - Ethernet (Port 1) | Multimode Fiber ST (Port 2) | Rear Serial (Port 3)

options.8: Dual 100BASE-FX MM LC | Single MM ST Fiber-Optic Serial | EIA-232
